tables.name: idempotency_records
tables.description: 幂等键账本（用户+项目+操作+键）；相同键不同载荷 409，演示期无限保留。

constraints.name: idempotency_records_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((operation = 'upload'::text) AND (paper_id IS NOT NULL) AND (task_id IS NOT NULL) AND (version_id IS NULL)) OR ((operation = ANY (ARRAY['process'::text, 'answer'::text, 'evidence'::text, 'draft'::text])) AND (paper_id IS NULL) AND (task_id IS NOT NULL) AND (version_id IS NULL)) OR ((operation = 'report-save'::text) AND (paper_id IS NULL) AND (task_id IS NULL) AND (version_id IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: idempotency_records_project_id_paper_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (project_id, paper_id) REFERENCES project_papers(project_id, paper_id)

constraints.name: idempotency_records_project_id_task_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (project_id, task_id) REFERENCES tasks(project_id, task_id)

constraints.name: idempotency_records_project_id_version_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (project_id, version_id) REFERENCES report_versions(project_id, version_id)

indexes.name: idempotency_records_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idempotency_records_pkey ON public.idempotency_records USING btree (user_id, project_id, operation, key)
